limitations: Four Gurn-variant transportees appear across 1614-1775, the earliest Mary Gurney (Middlesex, Mar 1683); none falls in the 1614-1665 window.
The collection indexes only transported felons and bonded servants; a free emigrant is out of scope by construction - this bounds the 'not a bonded man' reading, not John's emigration generally.
A transportee under a spelling outside Gurn* would not be caught.
